user.title: Add a legacy 352 air device
user.description: Enter the current LAN address, MAC address, and exact retail model. Identity verification is read-only; no device setting changes before the optional schedule step.

confirm_model.title: Confirm the device model
confirm_model.description: The local protocol identifies a device family, but cannot distinguish every retail model in that family.

schedule_cleanup.title: Handle device-local recurring schedules
schedule_cleanup.description: Optionally clear all four recurring on/off schedule slots stored inside the purifier. This is off by default and does not delete Home Assistant automations. When selected, the integration sends one clear write and requires two successful empty reads. If it fails, retry or turn this option off to keep the current schedules.

data.clear_local_schedules: Clear recurring on/off schedules stored in the purifier

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure device
reconfigure.description: Update the LAN address or model and verify the device with a read-only probe. The next step can optionally clear device-local schedules.

error.cannot_connect: No valid reply was received from the device
error.model_mismatch: The selected model does not match the discovered protocol family
error.schedule_cleanup_failed: The schedules could not be cleared and verified; retry, or turn the option off to keep them

abort.cannot_connect: No valid reply was received from the device
abort.unsupported_device: The discovered protocol family is not supported
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The MAC address belongs to a different configured device

command_failed.message: The device did not confirm the command

unsupported_option.message: This option is not supported by the selected model

unsupported_preset.message: This preset is not supported by the selected model

unsupported_timer.message: This timer duration is not supported by the device
